title: Uniform dropdown/select/menu type-scale — one --dropdown-text token pair the whole picker family reads
headline: The whole shadcn picker family (Select / DropdownMenu / Combobox / ContextMenu / Command + MultiSelect) converges onto ONE governed two-rung type-scale — --dropdown-text (primary) + --dropdown-text-secondary (secondary) — that every item, trigger, label, heading, shortcut, input, and empty reads; the two filter inputs share one height register (--dropdown-input-height); the scattered raw text-sm/text-xs leak excised; a consumer re-tints the family from ONE override. Landed AS a specialization of W51's --control-text comfort register (one scale system, not three).

fourRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: git show HEAD:src/styles/tokens.css | grep -c dropdown-text = 0; menuItemVariants.ts text-sm + 13+ raw text-sm/text-xs across SelectTrigger/SelectLabel/DropdownMenuLabel/Shortcut/ContextMenuLabel/Shortcut/ComboboxInput/Empty/Group/CommandInput/Empty/Shortcut/Group.

fourRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: section labels at text-sm in Select/DropdownMenu/ContextMenu but text-xs in Combobox/Command group-headings — the same conceptual section-label role at two scales.

fourRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.witness: RED 3 — the two filter inputs scale-mismatch on font AND height
fourRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: ComboboxInput h-10 + text-sm vs CommandInput h-11 + text-sm — the same picker-filter role at two heights, neither font reading a token.

fourRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.witness: RED 4 — the scale is not overridable from one token
fourRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: every site a raw literal, so a :root { --dropdown-text } override is dead (no component reads it). The only path is per-call-site class overrides — the anti-pattern the token-first axis kills.

folds.gestaltFix: Mint --dropdown-text: var(--control-text) + --dropdown-text-secondary: var(--control-text-sm) + --dropdown-input-height: var(--control-h-md) in tokens.css (SPECIALIZATIONS of W51's comfort register — one scale system), bridged in theme.css (--text-dropdown / --text-dropdown-secondary) so the text-dropdown Tailwind utility resolves. The family scale-contract recorded in a tokens.css section comment.

ratifyRecords.sectionLabelRung: RESOLVED -> secondary (--dropdown-text-secondary). The Select/DropdownMenu/ContextMenu labels collapse to the same rung as the Combobox/Command group-headings (a section label is a quieter-than-item caption).
